reason: I would sign up because it is free, but I will not pay a 10% cut on jobs until I see real requests coming in. I have no idea how many jobs per month this brings to a shop like mine, and I cannot plan my staff or my cash on a promise.
objection: How do I know real customers will come and how many jobs per month? If the inbox is empty or full of tyre-kickers, the commission is pure cost and my technicians sit idle.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing proof from shops like mine in Riyadh or Cairo: a real count of requests and booked jobs per month in my area, and a clear view of who the customers are before I commit.
